sections.heading: Settings » General Settings » Social Media Tab
sections.content:
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000558389
This article reviews links for the Social Media accounts for the website,  members and visitors will be able to access the full spectrum of profiles available for the website and it helps link the social media world to the website

sections.heading: Social Media Accounts
sections.content:
Below is a full list of the Social Media accounts linked to the website.
Important note: The system will ask for absolute URLs. For example:
facebook.com will not be accepted https://www.facebook.com will be accepted

sections.heading: 1. Facebook
sections.content: Add a link to the website's facebook account using the following format: https://www.facebook.com/CompanyFacebook

sections.heading: 2. Twitter
sections.content: Add a link to the website's Twitter account using the following format: https://www.twitter.com/CompanyTwitter

sections.heading: 3. LinkedIn
sections.content: Add a link to the website's LinkedIn account using the following format: https://www.linkedin.com/CompanyLinkedIn

sections.heading: 4. Pinterest
sections.content: Add a link to the website's Pinterest account using the following format: https://www.pinterest.com/CompanyPinteres

sections.heading: 5. Instagram
sections.content: Add a link to the website's Instagram account using the following format: https://www.instagram.com/CompanyInstagram

sections.heading: 6. Youtube
sections.content: Add a link to the website's Youtube account using the following format: https://www.youtube.com/CompanyYouTube

sections.heading: 7. RSS Feed
sections.content: Add a link to the website's RSS feed using the following format: https://www.yourwebsite.com/rss

sections.heading: 8. Tik Tok
sections.content: Add a link to the website's TikTok account using the following format: https://www.tiktok.com/@name

sections.heading: 9. Whatsapp
sections.content: Add a link to the website's WhatsApp account using the following format: https://wa.me/1XXXXXXXXXX

sections.heading: 10. Snapchat
sections.content: Add a link to the website's Snapchat accout using the following format: https://www.snapchat.com/add/username

sections.heading: Where Do These Links Appear?
sections.content: Inside the Footer Menu of the website:
